verdict.rationale: Zep's pricing page offers a deployment choice between its Cloud and the customer's own VPC. That implies customers can control where their data lives by running Zep in their own infrastructure, but it is a single thin marketing mention with no residency detail. Missing for 10: documented region selection for Zep Cloud (e.g., US/EU), explicit data-residency guarantees, documentation of how VPC deployment pins data location, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
